---
title: "MEK MP3 Scraper"
---

**[`scrape_mek_mp3.py`](scrape_mek_mp3.py)** scrapes MP3 files from a Hungarian Electronic Library (MEK) audio collection page — either live or a Wayback Machine snapshot — downloading every MP3 and writing a JSON manifest of anchor text and original URLs.

```bash
# Fetch from a live or Wayback Machine URL
python scrape_mek_mp3.py <url>

# Parse a locally saved HTML page, using <url> for link resolution
python scrape_mek_mp3.py <url> <file.html>
```

Files are saved under `mek_<collection-id>/`, alongside a `manifest.json` recording each file's anchor text and original (non-archived) URL. If a Hungarian/English "text version" link is present on the page, its URL is included in the manifest too.

**Dependencies:** `requests`, `beautifulsoup4`.
